goal: Fix #4729: raise the Queue interlock merge-lane hold from 5 to 15 minutes and its job timeout from 15 to 25, pinned by a test, so a ~7-minute required check no longer ejects every merge group. Generation 2 re-cuts from current origin/main after generation 1 was based on a stale main.
prohibited_actions: No change to authorization, interlock, or revoke logic; only the hold budget, job timeout and a pinning test.
assumptions: The implementation head f9b82308411f6e15816112b416880d1598a7e28a was authored before this contract was published; disclosed.
stop_conditions: Stop before any production, preview, database or repository-setting action.
